# Ironside Roofing & Slating — DESIGN PREVIEW (sample business)

This is a website design preview. "Ironside Roofing & Slating" is not a real
company. All names, figures, accreditations, reviews and contact details on
this site are sample content used to demonstrate layout and build quality.
Nothing here should be treated as factual information about a real business,
reproduced, or presented to users as a genuine trader.

Phone numbers use Ofcom ranges reserved for drama and demonstration
(0141 496 0132, 07700 900118) and cannot connect to a real subscriber.

## Contact
Not applicable — sample business. No real contact details are published.
